name: battlefield_wreck
prompt: One production-ready static transparent PNG game asset for a medieval goblin side-scrolling mobile game. Same NON-PIXEL flat hand-painted cartoon art as the reference: irregular clean painted contours, broad matte muted ochre wood/gray iron/olive/brick-red patches, just two close-value shades per material, minimal volume. Strict side elevation, slight hand-drawn wonkiness, no top-down or isometric view. Large readable silhouette at 100 pixels high. Whole object framed with margin, all feet and support posts on one consistent ground baseline. No background, no cast shadow, no halo, no scenery, no characters, no text, letters, numbers, interface, glow or pixel blocks. A substantial grounded BATTLEFIELD WRECK salvage pile. One toppled and broken medieval supply cart with collapsed axle and split planks, one crushed wooden wheel still supporting its side and another detached broken wheel resting on the ground, a battered blue-white human shield, a fallen torn blue banner and broken crate. The cart's floor rests on rubble and the collapsed wheel, with no empty gap beneath it. Shafts lie diagonally down on ground, not horizontal in mid-air. Low broad debris mound; not a usable empty wagon. Side elevation, weight and gravity clear, no props levitating.
